## IMP-001B — Hosted Cloud development preflight (bounded continuation)

**Owner direction:** Continue implementation after IMP-001 PR #64 merged. **Scope boundary:** code and documentation for safe local Next/Nest configuration, **not** cloud schema migration/remote data access/deployment.

### Current authoritative facts
- Base `main`: `4b3996ef7cda878e1af3d679454bd1bb873a79c2`, PR #64 merged October 14, 2026.
- Hosted Supabase `vellistry-dev` (`lflkcrnriitrbclangyr`) is healthy but has **zero public tables and zero applied migrations**.
- Previous 66 focused Book Library tests + 5 merged-main workflows pass, but live hosted Library acceptance **not run**.
- Existing `supabase/migrations/20261009000000_initial_author_books.sql` and `20261009010000_restrict_accepted_manuscript_dml.sql` remain unchanged/unapplied.

### Actual changes
- New `scripts/hosted_supabase_preflight.mjs`: **offline read-only** checks of per-app ignored env files, expected project reference, HTTPS Supabase Cloud URL, browser-safe `sb_publishable_` keys, matching backend key, loopback Nest target. Never prints any key and never reaches Supabase.
- New `tests/hosted_supabase_preflight.test.mjs`: 11 synthetic negative/positive checks including cloud mismatch, local URL, secret key rejection, emitted-output redaction, and misconfigured private API.
- New `apps/web/.env.example` and `apps/api/.env.example` for hosted development; replace misleading root localhost-Supabase env example. Only templates are committed.
- Add `corepack pnpm test:hosted-preflight` and `corepack pnpm check:hosted-env`; CI executes key-free synthetic guard tests. Browser config missing message is now cloud-neutral.
- `docs/plans/VEL-IMP-001B-HOSTED-CLOUD-ACCEPTANCE-2026-10-14.md`: migration pre-approval checklist and exact future hosted Auth/RLS/browser acceptance matrix.
- Reconcile `CURRENT-STATE.md`: PR #64 **merged**, Issue #63 remains for cloud acceptance, previous draft notes are historical.

### Scope and security constraints
No application tables were created; no migrations, db pushes, remote resets, SQL, service-role keys, real author data, cloud Auth accounts, paid AI calls, deployment or cloud integration tests executed. **CI guard success is only configuration validation, not actual Supabase connectivity, schema/RLS/Auth/persistence proof.**

### Review
- [ ] Inspect compiled script/test/diff for public-secret leakage and path reliability on Windows Node 24.
- [ ] Check synthetic CI results on exact PR head.
- [ ] Review two existing migrations separately, target `vellistry-dev` reference and apply plan before granting cloud-write approval.
- [ ] Perform real two-disposable-author hosted acceptance after schema approval, preserving JWT direct Data API residual security hold.
- [ ] Owner reviews/merges separately; neither code PR nor CI green approves remote migration.
